name: PayEngine Payment Gateway
author: payengine

sections.description:
Consumer preferences for payment methods are rapidly evolving, and businesses need a seamless, secure, and scalable payment solution to keep up. PayEngine offers a robust and developer-friendly payment gateway, allowing businesses to accept payments effortlessly while ensuring a smooth checkout experience for customers.

🚀 Boost Conversions with a Seamless Checkout Experience

The PayEngine Payment Gateway enables businesses to:

  • Accept multiple payment methods – Process transactions via credit cards, debit cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and other modern payment solutions.
  • Offer a seamless user experience – Ensure fast, mobile-optimized, and responsive checkouts across all devices.
  • Reduce friction with 3D Secure (3DS) – Minimize fraud while ensuring a smooth customer experience.
  • Process refunds effortlessly – Easily issue partial or full refunds directly from WooCommerce.
  • Secure Transactions – All transactions are processed via PayEngine’s PCI-compliant infrastructure.
  • Enable both sandbox and live environments – Test transactions in a safe environment before going live.

Easy Integration & Developer-Friendly API

PayEngine offers a fully-documented API and developer-friendly tools for seamless integration.

  • View Payment API Documentation
  • Google Pay Documentation
  • Apple Pay Documentation

📌 Get Started Today

Give your customers a fast, secure, and optimized checkout experience with PayEngine Payment Gateway for WooCommerce.
sections.installation:
This section describes how to install the plugin and get it working.

  1. Upload the plugin in ‘/wp-content/plugins/’ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Set the plugin settings from the payment section in WP Admin
sections.changelog: This is the first version of this extension
